{{Top}}
A '''datacore''', also stylized as '''data core''', was a device capable of storing data. The [[Azzameen family]] owned a [[Comm unit/Legends|communications]] [[Comm Datacore|datacore]] which they kept aboard their [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Space station/Legends|station]] [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Home Base]].
